title: Keep the exact current mechanism without repeating the failed nonlinear transfer
statement: The acquired marked exclusion/field construction has energy-consistent bounded Metropolis rates, a canonical-particle/Gaussian-field invariant product, an exact protected-current counter and a non-Gaussian whole-horizon superexponential bound under an exp(CN) initial density ceiling. Its completed review preserves these claims with explicit stored-energy, preparation/residue-sector and conditional-future corrections. It does not establish the nonlinear density/action receiver. An invariant shifted law is not its preparation or mixing across conserved residue sectors. The stated field energy is EXCESS mean energy, not total thermal energy. Upper-bounded arbitrary reciprocal prefactors do not even warrant native exclusion hydrodynamics at g=0. Retained records must preserve the complete future Markov interface. Weighted activity/field replacement under tilted histories is missing; naive path comparison has divergent kappa N^2 cost in the useful counter regime. Metric geometry separately changes the desired rare-density target.
